args.title: Make password reset email link use correct base URL
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Currently, the password reset email link uses a base URL that defaults to "http://localhost:3000" when PUBLIC_URL is not set. This causes the link to be incorrect for users when the environment variable is missing or misconfigured. The change proposes to ensure that the base URL is correctly set from the environment for production or deployment, preventing links to localhost in email messages.
